final: WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS st, AVG(CASE WHEN s.spanmin <> 0 THEN s.gbsize*1.0/s.spanmin END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM g, o WHERE g.rate > o.overall
